act_title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

dialogue.t: We're early, so feel free to rest for now. Would you like some water?
Thanks! Oh, wait a minute, we're your managers. That should be our line...
Well, seems like the venue went all out for this meet-and-greet. Is attendance usually pretty high?
Yes. Events like this serve both as a warm-up for the performance and promotion for the dancers, so the Theater takes them quite seriously.

dialogue.sit: So what do you have to do?

dialogue.t: If this were an open house or a discussion, we'd need to interact face-to-face with the audience.
But for an autograph session like today, we only need to sign posters and commemorative albums.
Ohh, Paimon gets it! So whenever a fan comes up to you, you give 'em your brightest smile and say, "Thanks for always supporting me!"
Smiling isn't necessary, and neither is a "thank you". I don't know if you've managed other celebrities before... but I generally don't use exclamation marks either.
Oh, well... You do things your own way! Nothing wrong with that!

dialogue.sit: Just like the black snow swan.

dialogue.t: Yes... just like the black snow swan.
